steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Tch... the further in we go, the more Sea Terrors there are.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: It's getting dangerous...

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Maestro... how do I become like them...?
Gkh...

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Seaborn?!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: (It's the same one we saw on the deck. The Hunter's attacks didn't do any damage?!)

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: (How will it come at me? With its limbs? Its fangs?)

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: (My handcannon... I need to create distance—)

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Wait.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Wait a second! What's that on your belt?!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Why would you... could you be...?!
Graaaahhhh!!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Argh! *Cough*

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: (What strength! I barely managed to block it!)

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Do you have something to say, monster?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: I can't go down here... I won't!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: I'm an Inquisitor of Iberia!

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: *Cough*...

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: It has taken too long to burn away the nethersea brand.

steps.name: High Inquisitor Dario
steps.text: The situation's not looking good.

steps.name: Sea Terror
steps.text: (Numerous slithering sounds)

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: (I can see what's going on down there from here.)

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: How many hours have passed? How much longer can he hang on?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I... if I... no, don't think about it, Jordi. Focus!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: The Inquisition... Hurry...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Is that all?

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Grr...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Listen to your friends wail. The flower of Sal Viento at least had its beauty, but what about you?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: As my first dance lesson after waking up, I must say you're underwhelming.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: Gkh!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: It's getting away!

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I'll go after it. You go find the little Iberian bird.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: How are you feeling?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Better than ever. My memories are tumbling down like a waterfall from the heavens. It'll take a while for the full picture to emerge, though.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: And some of my more recent memories are rather embarrassing.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: I'll go. Your mind is still unstable.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Oh? Trying to steal my prey?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: It'll try to escape to the sea.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Of course it will. But it wasn't running just because it couldn't win.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: What did it find?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: We don't have time—

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: *cough* I'll never get used to handcannons.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Hey, where are you—

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Huh? The Abyssal Hunters?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hello, Irene. I see you've brought us more prey.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Did you just call me Irene? Have you... have you regained your memories?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Not entirely, but I know I'm in a great mood right now.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: This is not the time.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: That's the one from the deck. It's fast enough to dodge the captain's lunge.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I really must tip my hat to you, Irene. For chasing it all the way here without taking a scratch.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: I can't take credit for it. It hardly even attacked. Look, it's still not, even now.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I see... I thought it wouldn't be able to resist if we chatted like this and showed it an opening.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Your friend just left, you know. It's not too late to go after them.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Or are you a pacifist too?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: (Kazimierz, a landlocked country where Skadi stayed for a time. A place of sprawling grasslands and forests, the Land of Knights.)

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: (Knights...)

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Is it a coincidence? Or did something draw him there?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: This ship, Breogan. What did you intend to leave behind for your homeland? Where have you hidden the answer?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: ...Hmm.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: (Sea Terror carcasses? And not only that...)

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: (The wounds are clean and precise. They show no signs of resistance. Scents mingle in the air. The air here is stale.)

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: (What else is there on this ship?)

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Your belt and pocket watch are undoubtedly human in origin, and even in the Iberian style!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: What are you?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: It's stalling for time.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: This will get complicated if the other one gets back to the ocean.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Still not attacking? What a passive dance partner.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I'll take the lead, Skadi.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Right.
—Guh!
Guh... grrrr... gah...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Come on, fight back already. I'm starting to feel like the bad guy.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: It's not stalling for time!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: The sound of bells?! What?
(Sharp screech)
Bells echo through the empty hall.
The lights in the hall flash. The Seaborn lands in the direction of the throne while the three are distracted.
Yes, the throne.
There is a throne on this Iberian ship. A symbol of pride, power, arrogance, and deceit.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: It's like...
Specter trails off, knowing what she was about to say was far too absurd.
It wears a crown, and drapes itself in the same colors as the curtains. It kneels by the side of the throne, the two inextricably bonded with one another.
It resembles the queens and ministers of old, serving the golden sun of Iberia.
A silhouette emerges from behind the throne.
Irene raises her lantern over her head, trying to illuminate the shadowy figure.

steps.name: Seaborn?
steps.text: Why do you set foot on my ship?

steps.name: Seaborn?
steps.text: *cough* *cough* Pah.

steps.name: Seaborn?
steps.text: Who would ignore a question from the great Alfonso? Why are you here?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Why have you broken the silence, and come for MY Iberia, which had lain forgotten for decades?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: I will start with you. Answer me, child of Old Iberia.
Irene could not believe her eyes.
She'd seen the Seaborn's face before. She had devoted much time of her time during her Inquisitor training to the study of history, immersing herself in doctrines and creeds.
How dare this Seaborn claim to be Alfonso?
How dare it claim to be Iberia's greatest ship captain?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: —You, you can't possibly be the captain of this ship, monster!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Alfonso was almost fifty years-old sixty years ago, but you look even younger than the great hero was back then!
Irene knows she is shaken, but she cannot show weakness.
She reflexively raises her lantern, as her commanding officer would have.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Drop the mask, Seaborn!
The light of her lantern flickers. The tiny speck in the Inquisitor's hand seems to fit the word 'lost' better than the lights of this golden hall.
The Golden Age.
The 'Seaborn' briefly lays its eyes on Irene before turning away dismissively, rubbing 'Alfonso's' inhuman arm.
A short silence surrounds the hero.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: 'Seaborn'? I don't like that name.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Tell me your name, child of Old Iberia.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: I am Irene, Inquisitor of Iberia.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: And 'Old Iberia'? You dare defile the name of—

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: And you dare talk to me like that?!
(A screech interrupts the exchange)

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Agh!

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Where were you when we burned Victoria's ships and sunk the Lion King's honor to the bottom of the lake?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Where were you when I paved the streets of Sal Viento with pure gold, brought back in my ships?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Where were you when the Tercios darkened Leithanien's dawn like a black cloud?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: (Violent coughing) *cough* *cough* Pah.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: I am Alfonso, Duke of Old Iberia, Admiral of the Armada, Captain of the Stultifera, and King of my own kingdom. You, a mere Inquisitor, dare question me?
...(Shakes head impatiently)

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: So the church's fools have crossed the ocean to find me. What did you expect, a pat on the back?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Go back. No matter how you got here, the Stultifera Navis does not welcome you. Garcia, my chief mate... no need be so bothered by them.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: They will repay the sea a thousand fold for the blood they made you spill.

steps.name: Chief Mate
steps.text: Ah... (Nods)

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: Mocking the Inquisition is a serious crime in Iberia.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Did you not understand what I just said? Leave. There is not a single living soul on this ship, child of Old Iberia.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: We've sacrificed so much to—!

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: —I'm not here to ask for your permission!

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Such impertinence. This is why I never liked the church.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: A crime? Against a church too helpless to stand against even the feeble royal house?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: If you're really from Old Iberia, then tell me. Who is the incumbent pope? Carmen?

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: ...You know Saint Carmen's name?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Saint? A saint? Ha...

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Haha... A saint... Hahaha.

steps.name: Inquisitor Irene
steps.text: What are you laughing at?!

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: He didn't even have the mettle to become pope? Does he not feel ashamed when he sees himself in the mirror?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: No wonder it took you sixty years to find this place. It seems disaster has made Iberia weak.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: But no matter. Before the ship's doctor joined the corals, we discussed what might have become of Iberia. This is not unexpected.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: The floor that you stand on, this immaculate golden hall—THIS is the motherland I know.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: THIS is Iberia, not the backwater you speak of, half of which you refuse to see or understand.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: How far has the once-great empire fallen? Is it really so pathetic that it took you sixty years to find me?
Alfonso descends from the podium.
Irene takes a step back. Her lantern flickers.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: Now then, why are there two Ægir with you? There is no place for the Ægir in my Iberia.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: We meant no offense, Captain. We were merely chasing some ugly monsters, and mistook your chief mate for one of them.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: ...How did you survive so long here?

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: That's the question, ain't it, you Ægir fools? It's been so, so many years since I took up hunting, as a hobby. Either today or tomorrow should've been the day of reckoning.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: But you chased away my quarry. Now we must once again rely on those—

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: —No. Wait... no!

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: You... you are not Ægir! You're more than Ægir! Both of you!

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: What's your name?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: ...Skadi.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: No, no. No no no, Ægir. Don't try to deceive me. We may have been trapped on this ship for decades, but we are no fools.

steps.name: Captain Alfonso
steps.text: They call you Ishar-mla.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Did you hear the bells, Ulpianus?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: It's a miracle that anything works on this ship at all.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Here, the bells signal the start of the hunt.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: But who's the hunter, and who's the prey?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: The children of the ocean don't care. If they consider Alfonso to be their kin—albeit weakened—they're willing to offer their own flesh and blood, all to ensure the survival of the strong.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: A Hunter approaches.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Gladiia. She's too sharp. The skills I learned on land will only work for so long. She'll detect me soon.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: What will you do?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: What will YOU do?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Answering a question with a question? I... I'm interested in your choice, Ulpianus.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: I never expected to become interested in the Abyssal Hunters again, but Laurentina fascinates me. I see so much possibility in her.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: And you, you've made your choice of your own accord, while retaining your sanity. Have you noticed? More and more, you're becoming like one of us.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Can you reach the truth? Cast aside revelation, lay open the body of god, and learn the truth of the gods of the sea?

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: The answer you're seeking is tantalizing. Heh, look at me, showing curiosity. Perhaps there's something human in me yet.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: The revelation is imprinted upon the instincts of god's children. Our ways of thinking couldn't be more different.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: Oh my.

steps.name: Amaia
steps.text: You sound even more like a Seaborn than I do.
